title: UP DGMHUP ANM Training Online Registration 2026
organization: Directorate General of Medical & Health, Uttar Pradesh
vacancyDetails: ANM training seats in government training centres under DGMHUP for female candidates
qualification: Intermediate / 10+2 as per ANM training rules; science preference as notified
selectionProcess: Online application → Merit list → Document verification → Training admission
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, photo ID, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://training.dgmhup.in
2. Select ANM Training Registration
3. Register and fill form for female candidates
4. Pay fee online and upload documents
5. Submit by 31 July 2026 and track merit
shortDescription: UP DGMHUP ANM Training Online Registration 2026 – apply 1–31 July 2026 at training.dgmhup.in (female candidates).
content:
Directorate General of Medical & Health, Uttar Pradesh (DGMHUP) has invited online applications for ANM Training 2026.

Apply: 1 July 2026 to 31 July 2026 at training.dgmhup.in. Only female candidates meeting age and educational criteria should apply. Selection is typically merit-based.
